name: grass-main-a
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production seamless repeating ground-color texture for a warm, lush, hand-painted children's mobile farm game. Create ONE flat square 2048x2048 grass texture, strictly orthographic straight down, no perspective, no horizon. Style: painterly storybook mobile farm like the provided task concept: cheerful yellow-green grass, soft brushwork, small readable irregular grass tufts and clover, tiny sparse cream/yellow flowers, no dark outlines, no photoreal noise. The texture represents a 12 by 12 meter patch, so details must remain small and evenly distributed. Soft warm diffuse light from bottom left; only extremely subtle local shading toward upper right. Seamlessly tileable on BOTH axes: left and right edges must match perfectly, top and bottom edges must match perfectly in color, density and all crossing motifs. Completely opaque surface; fill every pixel. No paths, soil islands, large objects, trees, rocks, animals, text, labels, border, vignette, spotlights or large recognizable repeating blobs. Keep all four edge bands comparable to center. This is a usable standalone game material, not a material-sphere preview, not a collage. Variant A: balanced fresh meadow green with gentle warm chartreuse tips; low-contrast, calm base with tiny clover clusters and only a few flower flecks.

Preserve the warm sunny yellow-green grass, soft hand-painted style, small clover and tiny flower scale. Retain a brighter sunny green tone than the farm's regular meadow. name: path-patch-a

A softly painterly warm cheerful mobile farm style: warm honey-beige compacted soil at center, a few tiny subdued stones and faint foot scuffs, small yellow-green grass tongues entering from the irregular outer verge, soft blending at the verge into REAL TRANSPARENCY.
